name: Perihelion
description: Diagrams of three nested orbits that share one focus, the sun sitting in it and a single body somewhere on its path, turned every way.

code.style: --rule: ( --e: @r(0deg, 360deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: rotate(@r(0deg, 360deg)); background: radial-gradient(ellipse 6.5% 6.5% at 79.4% 50%, var(--color2) 100%, transparent 100%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 42% 30% at 50% 50%, transparent 92.67%, #000 92.67% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 26% 18.76% at 61.4% 50%, transparent 88.27%, #000 88.27% 100%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(ellipse 12% 10.9% at 74.4% 50%, transparent 79.82%, #000 79.82% 100%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse 5.2% 5.2% at 50% 50%, #000 100%, transparent 100%); transform: @p(translate(calc(0.0% + 42% * cos(@var(--e))), calc(30% * sin(@var(--e)))), translate(calc(11.4% + 26% * cos(@var(--e))), calc(18.76% * sin(@var(--e)))), translate(calc(24.4% + 12% * cos(@var(--e))), calc(10.9% * sin(@var(--e))))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
